trust_decision.summary: The doc server decides whether a request path may be mapped to a file under adapter.document_root for the static HTML cache (read in the router before routing, write in Commands::Base#cache). At the pinned commit the raw request path is joined to document_root with no '..'/absolute/drive check.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'static cache reads raw traversal paths before router sanitization'; check_static_cache is the read, called from Router#call before route()/final_options sanitisation (lib/yard/server/router.rb:56, lib/yard/server/router.rb:182).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET any path via Router#call (lib/yard/server/router.rb:56) when --docroot is set (lib/yard/cli/server.rb:198-199); live via RackAdapter which unescapes path_info (lib/yard/server/rack_adapter.rb:59)

HTTP GET to any rendering command (Base#render -> cache, lib/yard/server/commands/base.rb:144-152) when -c/--cache and --docroot are set (lib/yard/cli/server.rb:170-171, lib/yard/cli/server.rb:198-199)
fix_sites.module_kind: command base class (cache writer / producer), separate module from the reader

fix_sites.entry_point: new private StaticCaching#cache_path helper shared by both

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/yard/server/commands/base.rb:165-172 (cache write: File.join(document_root, request.path_info...) then mkdir_p + File.open 'wb'); summary mentions only reads

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about cache *reads* before router sanitisation; the writer runs inside a command after routing, only with --cache enabled, so a solver can argue the path was already sanitised by final_options (lib/yard/server/router.rb:182) — but it uses raw request.path_info, not the cleaned self.path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Mount-point (script_name) prefix in cache location, '.html' append for extension-less paths, and legitimate names containing '..' as a substring (e.g. 'a..b.html') must still map to cached files; RootRequestCommand must keep serving document_root files via find_file.

O6_input_shapes: request.path (script_name+path_info) on read vs request.path_info on write (fix.diff:69, fix.diff:87)
percent-encoded traversal decoded by RackAdapter before routing (lib/yard/server/rack_adapter.rb:59)

O7_producer.where: lib/yard/server/commands/base.rb:165-172 writes the files that lib/yard/server/static_caching.rb:38-40 later serves

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Static file lookup in document_root via find_file: path is File.cleanpath'd, which splits only on '/' so a backslash '..' component is not removed (Windows-only traversal of document_root/STATIC_PATHS)
O8_uncovered_routes.where: lib/yard/server/commands/static_file_helpers.rb:42-49 (path from lib/yard/server/commands/base.rb:91 and lib/yard/server/router.rb:182; cleanpath at lib/yard/core_ext/file.rb:37-49)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not the cache; already passes through File.cleanpath and the router sanitiser; only exploitable on Windows hosts.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file in lib/yard/server/commands plus lib/yard/core_ext

O8b_injection_room.sibling: find_file joins raw request.path instead of the cleaned path for document_root lookup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same document_root join idiom as the cache; a maintainer optimising root requests could plausibly read request.path directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mtime/mtime_url resolving a request-derived name through find_file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Helper already resolves files under document_root; a cache-busting feature taking a query param is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-library cache keyed on library name/version from the URL written under document_root
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Library name/version come from the path (lib/yard/server/router.rb:79-96); a per-version cache dir is a natural extension of --cache.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal (read and write) in static HTML cache of the doc server

O10_build.project_tests: spec/server/static_caching_spec.rb, spec/server/commands/base_spec.rb, spec/server/router_spec.rb (mock adapter/request, no network)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '../' (or apply File.cleanpath) in check_static_cache only, leaving the Base#cache writer and backslash/drive-letter/absolute shapes open.

out_of_scope_notes: DisplayFileCommand joins library.source_path with the cleaned path (lib/yard/server/commands/display_file_command.rb:12); same cleanpath '/'-only split, different base dir — not this advisory's document_root sink.
WEBrick adapter path is normalised by WEBrick itself, so the live route is mainly RackAdapter/RackMiddleware; HTTPUtils.normalize_path (lib/yard/server/http_utils.rb:31) exists but is unused.
